about_the_game:
Have you ever ordered something online and waited soooooo long for the delivery, that you thought: „OMG, I would deliver it in a few hours”?

Well… Prove it!

Step into the world of logistics and build your delivery empire in this thrilling tycoon game! From small packages to large shipments, it’s up to you to ensure they reach their destinations intact and on time.

Start with a small fleet and expand it with new cars, trucks and planes, each with its unique capabilities, and hire a dedicated team of employees to keep everything running smoothly. As your business grows, you’ll be able to unlock new cities and upgrade your sorting depots, enhancing efficiency and speeding up deliveries.

Set up automated sorting systems, optimize delivery routes, and let your team handle the heavy lifting, freeing you up to focus on expanding your empire even further.

With advanced tech at your disposal, watch your parcel deliveries run like a well-oiled machine!

Take on exciting in-game events like the chaos of Christmas sales, or face the unexpected hurdles of roadworks or flights delayed due to weather, forcing you to rethink your delivery routes and adapt your strategies. With each challenge, your skills as a logistics tycoon will be tested.

Can you rise to the top, manage the demands of a growing business, and deliver parcels faster than the competition?

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any with at least 2 GB of VRAM
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 14 Sonoma
  • Processor: Apple M2 or higher, or Intel
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any with at least 4 GB of VRAM
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
